title: self_movement
summary: MSUI implements the MSG_MOVE_* stream with correct MovementInfo tails, explicit swim start/stop and pitch, teleport/worldport, all six force-speed changes, the complete root/water-walk/feather-fall/hover grant family, and server-owned self-spline riding plus completion acknowledgment. Every addressed change echoes the counter and live mover pose; non-root mode acks carry the required apply dword. Self rides retain the server spline id, park client physics/input, ack the newest completed/stopped id, and yield to teleport hand-backs.

openItems.text: CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE never sent - a server-authored spline addressed to the player (taxi end, charge, knockback) is never acked, so vmangos SplineDonePending relocation/rebroadcast is left to its timeout fallback
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: The retained SMSG_MONSTER_MOVE spline id follows the self ride through the shared sampler. On natural completion or an explicit replacement Stop, MSUI sends exact CMSG_MOVE_SPLINE_DONE [MovementInfo][u32 id][f32 1.0], releases input lock and resumes at rest. Same-map/far teleport hand-backs clear the ride without an extra ack.

openItems.text: SMSG_FORCE_RUN/RUN_BACK/SWIM/WALK_SPEED_CHANGE (and turn-rate) have no handler and CMSG_FORCE_*_SPEED_CHANGE_ACK is never sent - Benilla documents the ack as mandatory (server force-resolves after ~4 s and flags anticheat)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Run, run-back, swim, swim-back, walk and turn-rate changes parse their packed-guid/counter/f32 body, apply to the controlled speed state, and ack on the kind-specific opcode with exact full-guid/counter/live-pose/speed layout.

openItems.text: Granted move-mode acks CMSG_MOVE_WATER_WALK_ACK / CMSG_MOVE_FEATHER_FALL_ACK / CMSG_MOVE_HOVER_ACK missing (only root/unroot is acked); un-acked, the server never applies the mode
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: Water-walk, feather-fall and hover apply/remove opcodes share one strict parser/state lane and emit the exact kind-specific ack with mandatory apply dword; focused golden coverage pins the root/non-root four-byte difference.
